item.title: My Self Hosting Journey after ~18 months
item.description: It’s been around a year and a half since I started self hosting. It all started when I bought a Raspberry Pi for no good reason. I installed a few apps before succumbing to compute limits. At times, it would randomly shut down because it could not get enough power. I cannot even plug an HDD as it would pull too much power. I bought a used Dell Optiplex from a second-hand seller. I think it was a company pull-out which was fine as I got it for just ~1000 PHP. I then upgraded the SSD and the RAM which took ~9000 PHP (this was before the RAMpocalypse and the SSD shortage). And now, for a year, it is going very smoothly.
